card.name: Inside interacting drug names and co-use words
card.fires_on: Partway through drug names (ketoconazole, ritonavir, voriconazole) and words like coadministered or concomitantly in drug-interaction text. Also on words like benefited or joint that describe two parties sharing something.

modes.label: Interacting drug names
modes.description: Inside azole and protease-inhibitor names listed in interaction tables or sentences.

modes.label: Co-use wording
modes.description: Partway through coadministered or concomitantly, where two drugs are given together.

modes.label: Shared benefit
modes.description: Words in general text describing an arrangement that benefits both sides.
modes.example: in an agreement that<< benefited>> both.

card.writes: Promotes words meaning mutual or two-way (双方, mutual, 相互), fitting the idea of two parties acting on each other.
card.plain: It fires in drug-interaction text where two drugs affect each other, and in text about something shared by both sides.
